cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies who delivered a live neonate in a tertiary care center, comparing those with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) to age-, gestational age-, and parity-matched women without medical comorbidities.
finding: Diabetic women had a significantly higher incidence of postpartum depression in both the immediate postpartum period and at 6 weeks postpartum compared to non-diabetic women, while maternal anxiety and mother-child bonding were comparable between the groups.
